name: Thu Khoa Huan statue
nameVi: Tượng đài Thủ Khoa Nguyễn Hữu Huân
kicker: Statue in the old station garden
summary: Use the Thủ Khoa Huân statue as the pin of the evening walk, in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng where đường 30 Tháng 4 meets Trưng Trắc. Báo Xây dựng places the old Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho station here. The rails stopped in 1958, and no passenger train runs. A ticket was not printed. The fee and a timed visit are check on arrival.
getThere: On the embankment, at vườn hoa Lạc Hồng
heroCaption: The statue above the garden trees, face and crossed arms in frame

notice.title: No train stops here
notice.body: The Sài Gòn–Mỹ Tho railway stopped in 1958. The station is a memory at this garden. Do not wait for a train.

body: The statue and the garden mark the river corner of the town, at đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc. That was old phường 1. It is now inside phường Mỹ Tho. Báo Xây dựng says the Saigon–My Tho rails ended in front of what is now vườn hoa Lạc Hồng and this statue. Walk here late in the afternoon, with the embankment.

Bảo tàng Tiền Giang names Nguyễn Hữu Huân among the later-19th-century scholars in its display. The museum tells that story. The statue is the pin in the garden. A biographical panel at the statue was not opened, so this page does not add a life story. The pedestal in the photograph carries his name. A ticket was not printed.

Give it a few minutes on the walk, not a museum hour. The electric cart starts and ends on this embankment, at số 01 Hoàng Sa. Looking for a working station wastes the visit. The planned Ho Chi Minh City–Cần Thơ railway does not name a Mỹ Tho station.

figures.caption: The pedestal in the garden, with the river and boats behind

gettingThere: The statue is in vườn hoa Lạc Hồng, on đường 30/4 and đường Trưng Trắc, phường Mỹ Tho. A room on đường 30 Tháng 4 is already on this walk. The tourist pier is on the same embankment, at số 01 Hoàng Sa. Minutes between them were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From a room on đường 30 Tháng 4
legs.body: Walk. This garden is the base. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the pier at 01 Hoàng Sa
legs.body: Walk the embankment. The cart also starts here, 07:00–22:00. A minute count for the walk was not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: No closing day is published. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No ticket was printed. Check on arrival. The cart, if you ride it, is a separate fare.
